card.name: Digits in nuclear imaging agent names
card.fires_on: Single digits inside radioisotope names such as Rb 82, Tl 201 and Tc 99m, and the first digit of section numbers like 2.4, in nuclear imaging labels. Also weakly on 'stress' and 'and' in stress-imaging phrases.
